system.description: Expend three Blood Traits and direct the Beast to manifest in a body part, which becomes encrusted with dried black vitae. Hands: punches inflict aggravated damage. Body: gain six bonus Physical Traits of your choice. Throat: emit an unearthly roar; hearers must win a Courage Test (difficulty your Social Traits) or flee, and supernatural beings are two Traits down on all challenges. Feet: kicks inflict aggravated damage, and you can stomp to cause tremors that knock down everyone within 100 feet who loses a Physical Challenge, lasting as long as you stamp. Effects last one scene.
